Because the marble weight is recomputed from the bridge history each close, the saffron audit exposes the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 6 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 26% of full weight. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
